# COORD-JOH-G — Johnston cumulative statistic G and displacement J_r

- **Family:** prime-side
- **Notation:** G(N), J_r, B(n)
- **Definition:** G(N) = sum_{2<=n<N} (pi(n) - Q(n) - 1) = A(N) - T(N) - L(N); J_r = sum_{r^2<k<(r+1)^2} ((r+1)^2 - k) eta(k).
